Your notes back up that you own Tansley Parcel, so you're fine. But Tobias is a Central team account manager, not the owner, so sending the rate to him needs approval from June or Anselm. Saving the draft myself would be doing the very thing that's waiting on her answer. His address is internal (trendle@pemberline.com), so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve anything.

**What I did:**
- **June:** I messaged her directly to ask for approval, and logged it as a pending request.
- **You:** I sent you a reply in our DM explaining the hold.

As soon as June says yes, I'll save the draft in your mailbox. It will be to Tobias, with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate" and the proposed 2027 rate of $1,313 a seat for the planning sheet. Nothing gets sent; you'll send it yourself. If June says no, I'll tell you and won't save it.
